verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only MCP server mode: Crawl4AI exposes its own crawling to AI tools like Claude Code. That is the server role and does not show Crawl4AI acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers and uses their tools. A crawler with LLM-driven extraction could plausibly consume MCP tools, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence it does.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
